props.children: Everything Hermes reads goes to its chat model (now: gpt-x). For Telegram it must be a Venice private model or a model on this host.
Venice: base URL https://api.venice.ai/api/v1, your Venice API key, and a private model such as e2ee-deepseek-v4-flash or deepseek-v4-flash.
Or a local server (Ollama / LM Studio) at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1.
Select that model for chats, then press Check again.
